copy.coverage_description: Discover the records that help you understand a boat before you make your next move.
copy.accident_body: Explore available incident records, reported damage, insurance losses and salvage information for the vessel.
copy.title_body: Review ownership records and available title or lien information before completing your purchase.

copy.steps_description: From hull number to helpful records, the process is straightforward.
copy.step_1_body: Enter the 12 letters and numbers shown on your vessel. You can usually find the HIN on the transom.
copy.step_2_body: Check your HIN and report details at Shopify checkout, then complete your payment.
copy.step_3_body: We send your PDF report to the email address on your order. Check the delivery time shown before you purchase.
copy.history_note: Use the available records alongside a professional marine survey and your own checks to make an informed decision.
copy.services_description: Available information is organized into clear sections so you can review the vessel with confidence.
copy.service_1_body: Check available reports of collisions, fires and groundings to understand the incidents connected with a vessel.
copy.service_2_body: Review documented structural, mechanical or cosmetic damage and any available repair information.
copy.service_3_body: Look for recorded total losses and salvage history that may be relevant to the boat you are considering.
copy.service_4_body: Explore available records of storm damage, repairs and associated insurance losses.
copy.service_5_body: Review available records of reported theft and recovery linked to the vessel.
copy.service_6_body: See matching recall information and manufacturer notices where records are available.
copy.reviews_editor: Add genuine customer reviews using the theme editor. This section stays hidden until a review is added.
